title: How Currencies Actually Work (Full Beginner's Guide)

chapters.title: Bretton Woods and the Nixon Shock
Is a Strong Currency the Goal?

description:
How do currency exchange rates actually work? Why does the value of the dollar, euro, yen, or other currencies change every second? And who actually decides what one currency is worth compared to another? In this complete beginner’s guide, we explain how currencies and foreign exchange rates work from the ground up. You’ll learn how the forex market determines currency prices, why currencies rise and fall, and what causes exchange rates to change.
